sloka: पर्वतान् चूर्णष्यामि प्लवमानः प्लवंगमाः ।हरिष्यामि ऊरु वेगेन प्लवमानो महाअर्णवम् ॥४-६७-१८॥
transliteration: parvatān cūrṇaṣyāmi plavamānaḥ plavaṁgamāḥ ।hariṣyāmi ūru vegena plavamāno mahāarṇavam ॥4-67-18॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys when I leap, I can crush the mountains into powder and pull the vast ocean with me with the force of my thighs.
